This open R project provides a manifest-driven foundation for downloading,
validating, harmonizing, and documenting public-use NHANES data.

The current release covers Complete Blood Count and Demographics from 1999–2000
through 2017–2018, with explicit protection against accidental use of the
unweighted 2001–2002 second-exam convenience sample.

## Start here

- Read the [CBC and Demographics data guide](NhanesDownloadScripts.qmd).
- Review the [source code](https://github.com/simonaseno/NHANES).
- Inspect the [source catalog](https://github.com/simonaseno/NHANES/blob/main/config/nhanes_files.csv).
- Report a problem or request a component through
  [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/simonaseno/NHANES/issues).

## Design principles

- Official CDC sources only.
- Fail-fast source and schema validation.
- Explicit record granularity and merge contracts.
- Separate scientific harmonization from generic acquisition.
- Reproducible versions, provenance hashes, and automated checks.
- Citation-ready releases rather than unversioned generated data.
